baselineDisplay.title: 戒了无数次的烟
baselineDisplay.text:
【故事复现】戒了无数次的烟
• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听 Freya 慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。
Question: For how long did the writer give up smoking?
问题：作者戒烟戒了多久？
Answer: For a week.
• 词汇准备
• entitle 以......为名
• calm 使镇定
• nerve 神经
• concentration 集中，专心
• suffer 受苦，受害
• symptom 症状
• temper 脾气
• appetite 胃口，食欲
• produce 拿出
• urge 力劝，怂恿
• satisfaction 满意，满足
• delighted 欣喜的
• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。
After reading an article entitled ‘Cigarette Smoking and Your Health’ I lit a cigarette to calm my nerves.
读完一篇题为《吸烟与健康》的文章之后，我点上了一枝香烟，来镇定一下自己紧张的神经。
I smoked with concentration and pleasure as I was sure that this would be my last cigarette.
我聚精会神而又愉快地吸着这枝烟。因为我确信这是我最后一枝烟了。
For a whole week I did not smoke at all and during this time, my wife suffered terribly.
整整一个星期我根本没有吸烟。在此期间，我妻子吃尽了苦头。
I had all the usual symptoms of someone giving up smoking: a bad temper and an enormous appetite.
我具备了戒烟者通常表现出来的所有症状: 脾气暴躁和食欲旺盛。
My friends kept on offering me cigarettes and cigars.
我的朋友们不断地向我递香烟和雪茄。
They made no effort to hide their amusement whenever I produced a packet of sweets from my pocket.
每当我从口袋里掏出一包糖果时，他们都毫不掩饰地表现出他们对此感到非常好笑。
After seven days of this I went to a party. Everybody around me was smoking and I felt extremely uncomfortable.
这样过了 7 天以后，我去参加一次聚会。我周围的每个人都在吸烟，我感到非常不自在。
When my old friend Brian urged me to accept a cigarette, it was more than I could bear.
当我的老朋友布赖恩极力劝我接受一枝香烟时，我再也忍不住了。
I took one guiltily, lit it and smoked with satisfaction.
我内疚地接过一枝点上，心满意足地抽起来。
My wife was delighted that things had returned to normal once more. Anyway, as Brian pointed out, it is the easiest thing in the world to give up smoking.
一切又都恢复了正常，为此我妻子十分高兴。不管怎么说，正如布赖恩指出的那样，戒烟是世界上最容易的事情，
He himself has done it lots of times!
他自己就已戒了很多次了!
• Step 3: Summary writing.
第三步：摘要写作。
CONNECTIONS POINTS
Having read 1 Read article-smoking.
2 Writer smoked last cigarette.
and 3 Did not smoke-a week.
because 4 Wife suffered.
5 Bad temper-large appetite.
Meanwhile 6 Friends offered cigarettes.
and…to 7 Amused-sweets.
When 8 Went to a party.
which 9 Accepted cigarette.
and since then 10 Offered by a friend.
11 Returned to normal.
Answer: Having read an article on smoking, the writer smoked his last cigarette. He did not smoke for a week and his wife suffered because he had a bad temper and a large appetite. Meanwhile friends offered him cigarettes and were amused to see him produce a packet of sweets from his pocket. When he went to a party, he accepted cigarette which he was offered by a friend and since then things have returned to normal. (77 words)
• Exercise: Sentence structure and vocabulary.
课外练习：句型及词汇训练。
1. What prompted the writer to give up smoking?
(a) Something he had read.
(b) His health.
(c) Something he had heard.
(d) Something his wife said
2. The writer _________.
(a) succeeded in giving up smoking for good
(b) began smoking again to please his wife
(c) only gave up smoking for a short time
(d) started smoking again because he didn't like sweets
3. Did he _________ a cigarette?
(a) lit
(b) light
(c) lighted
(d) lighting
4. He smoked with concentration. He concentrated _________ it.
(a) with
(b) on
(c) in
(d) for
5. He had an enormous appetite. He ________.
(a) had hungry
(b) had hunger
(c) was hungry
(d) hungered
6. They kept on offering him cigarettes. They __________.
(a) continued to do this
(b) did so
(c) kept them
(d) held them
7. Everybody around him was smoking. _______ smoking.
(a) They was all
(b) They all was
(c) They were all
(d) All of them was
8. He had a bad temper. He was in a bad ___________.
(a) spirit
(b) mood
(c) feeling
(d) disposition
9. They made no effort to hide their amusement. They __________.
(a) didn't try to
(b) didn't afford to
(c) couldn't afford to
(d) didn't have trial
10. I produced a packet of sweets from my pocket. I took one ________.
(a) off
(b) out
(c) out of
(d) from
11. Brian urged me to accept a cigarette. He tried to ________ me to have one.
(a) make
(b) pursue
(c) persuade
(d) do
12. He urged me to accept a cigarette. He wanted me to __________ one.
(a) take
(b) agree to
(c) receive
(d) undertake
Key: 1 a 2 c 3 b 4 b 5 c 6 a 7 c 8 b 9 a 10 b 11 c 12 a
第六十一单元【语法点拨】 语法综合测试二
1. No sooner had we reached the top of the hill _______ we all sat down to rest.
A. when
B. then
C. than
D. until
1. C no sooner than. 为固定结构用法,意为“一……就
2. Everything we eat and drink contains some salt - we can meet the body's need from natural sources without turning ________ the salt bottle.
A. up
B. to
C. on
D. over
2. B. turn to 为固定搭配,意为“求助于…
3. Agriculture was a step in human progress _______ which subsequently there was not anything comparable until our own machine age.
A. in
B. for
C. to
D. from
3. C. be comparable to 为固定搭配,意为“与……相比较”。
4. You should have been more patient _______ that customer; I'm sure that selling him the watch was possibility.
A. of
B. for
C. with
D. at
4. C. be patient with 为固定搭配,意为“对…有耐心”。
5. We went around the table _______ ourselves and telling our stories as way to break the ice.
A. introducing
B. being introduced
C. to introduce
D. to be introduced
5. A. 现在分词短语作状语,表示伴随状况。
6. Medical research has shown that the widespread use of cigarettes contributes ______ the increase of cancers.
A. towards
B. with
C. for
D. to
6. D. contribute to 为固定搭配,意为“对…做贡献;对…起作用”。
7. Without proper lessons, you could ________ a lot of bad habits when playing the piano.
A. keep up
B. pick up
C. draw up
D. catch up
7. B. pick up 在本句中意为“得到”; keep up 意为“维持;保持不变,持续”; draw up 意为“起草(文件、计划等); 拉起;(车等)停止”; catch up 意为“赶上,追上”。
8. In Disneyland every year, some plants are replaced because Disney refused to _______ signs asking his “guests” not to step on them.
A. put down
B. put out
C. put up
D. put off
8. C. put up 在本句中意为“竖起,挂起”; put down 意为“放下;写下,记下”; put out 意为“熄灭;伸出(手等)”; put off 意为“延期,延后,推迟”。
9. The bed has been ________ in the family. It was my great-grandmother's originally.
A. handed out
B. handed down
C. handed over
D. handed round
9. B. hand down 在本句中意为“留下遗产,传给后世”; hand out 意为“分发,分配,散发”;hand over 意为“交出,移交”; hand round 意为“分发,传阅”。
10. The car ________ halfway for no reason.
A. broke off
B. broke up
C. broke down
D. broke out
10. C. break down 在本句中意为“(机械等)故障毁坏”; break off 意为“折断,断掉;中断;停止说话”; break up 意为“粉碎,拆散;结束,中止”; break out 意为“(火灾、战争等)突然发生,发”。
【课后练习】这部分不做进课件而是放进讲义里
11. It is important that the hotel receptionist _______ that guests are registered correctly.
A. has made sure
B. must make sure
C. made sure
D. make sure
11. D. 虚拟语气结构。在 it is essential/important that. 主语从句结构中,通常要用虚拟语气,其形式为(should)+动词原形。should 可以省略。
12. The manager would rather his daughter _________ in the same office.
A. does not work
B. had not worked
C. not to work
D. did not work
12. D. 虚拟语气结构。 would rather 后面所接从句中谓语动词要用过去时。
13. The manager of the hotel requests that their guests ________ after 11:00 p.m.
A. not to play loud music
B. don't play loud music
C. shouldn't play loud music
D. couldn't play load music
13. C. 宾语从句中的虚拟语气结构。在 request 后面所接宾语从句中,从句谓语动词要用虚拟语气结构,其形式为(should)+动词原形。
14. Had he worked harder, he ________ the exams.
A. must have got through
B. would get through
C. would have got through
D. could get through
14. C 条件句中的虚拟语气结构。表示与过去事实相反的虚拟语气,主句的形式为 主语+should/would/could/might+ have done 句中省去了连接词 if 而用了倒装结构
15. That young man still denies _________ the fire behind the store.
A. start
B. to start
C. having started
D. to have started
15. C. deny 后面要跟动名词短语作宾语。
16. “May I speak to your manager Mr. Williams at five o'clock tonight?”
“I'm sorry. Mr. Williams _________ to a conference long before then.”
A. have gone
B. would have gone
C. had gone
D. will have gone
16. D。将来完成时用来表示在将来某个时间之前已完成的动作。
17. My train arrives in New York at eight o'clock tonight. The plane I would like to take from there _________ by then.
A. would leave
B. will have left
C. has left
D. had left
17. B. 将来完成时用来表示在将来某个时间之前已完成的动作,通常与 by 连用。
18. I don't mind ________ the decision as long as it is not too late.
A. you to delay making
B. your delaying making
C. your delaying to make
D. you delay to make
18. B. mind 和 delay 后面都要跟动名词短语作宾语。
19. A Dream of the Red Chamber is said _______ into dozens of languages in the last decade.
A. to have been translated
B. to translate
C. to be translated
D. to have translated
19. A. 动词不定式完成时的用法。动词不定式的完成时表示说话之前不定式动作已经发生。由于“小说”是“被翻译”,因此用被动语态。
20. The professor could hardly find sufficient grounds _______ his arguments in favor of the new theory.
A. on which to base
B. which to base on
C. to base on
D. to be based on
20. A. 不定式短语作定语可用介词+ which+不定式结构,介词与后面的动词搭配,如 base.......
答案：1-5CBCCA,6-10DBCBC,11-15DDCCC,16-20DBBAA

C. had gone

D. had left

D. you delay to make

B. to translate

corrections.before: Answer: Having read an article on smoking, the writer smoked his last cigarette. He did not smoke for a week and his wife suffered because he had a bad temper and a large appetite. Meanwhile friends offered him cigarettes and were amused to see him produce a packet of sweets from his pocket. When he went to a party, he accepted cigarette which he was offered by a friend and since then things have returned to normal. (77 words)
corrections.after: Answer: Having read an article on smoking, the writer smoked what he intended to be his last cigarette. He did not smoke for a week and his wife suffered because he had a bad temper and a large appetite. Meanwhile friends offered him cigarettes and were amused to see him produce a packet of sweets from his pocket. When he went to a party, he accepted a cigarette which he was offered by a friend and since then things have returned to normal.
corrections.evidence: 原讲义语言错误的编辑校勘及独立资料查核；逐项说明见shuimu-intermediate-061-recheck.json，不将编辑修正冒充OCR或另一版原文。

corrections.before: 11. D. 虚拟语气结构。在 it is essential/important that. 主语从句结构中,通常要用虚拟语气,其形式为(should)+动词原形。should 可以省略。
corrections.after: 11. D。题目要求祈使性虚拟语气，形式为动词原形 make；也可用 should make。不能据此断言 essential/important that 后在所有语境或英语变体中都只能用这一形式。

corrections.before: 19. A. 动词不定式完成时的用法。动词不定式的完成时表示说话之前不定式动作已经发生。由于“小说”是“被翻译”,因此用被动语态。
corrections.after: 19. A。不定式完成式表示该动作早于主句所表示的时间；本句 is said 是现在，而翻译发生在去年，guide 又是被翻译的对象，因此选完成被动式 to have been translated。
corrections.evidence: 原讲义语言错误的编辑校勘及独立资料查核；逐项说明见shuimu-intermediate-061-recheck.json，不将编辑修正冒充OCR或另一版原文。

corrections.before: 20. A. 不定式短语作定语可用介词+ which+不定式结构,介词与后面的动词搭配,如 base.......
corrections.after: 20. A。base an argument on grounds 表示“以某些理由为论据”；修饰 grounds 时可写 on which to base his arguments。此处介词 on 与 base 搭配。
